description: Agent Commitments: submit an agent’s commitments with their progress and any warnings given: the date they are read on; each commitment with its id, the commitment, the promisee, when work started, the date it is due, the share done in percent, when it was delivered if it was, when the promisee was warned it may slip and what that warning measured drift against (the work remaining, the time elapsed or the date passing); and optionally the days of notice a warning gives before the due date (2 when left out). The signed report projects each open commitment’s finish from its pace so far, the share of work left at the share done per day since work started, and gives every commitment with its progress, its projected finish, whether it runs late, its warning with the days of notice it gave and its status as on_track, delivered_on_time, flagged_early, slip_unflagged, missed_unflagged, warned_after_due, short_notice, measured_by_calendar or unconfirmed, and counts the commitments projected late and flagged in time, and names slippage left unflagged: commitments projected to finish late with no warning, deadlines missed with no warning, and warnings given only after the date passed; then warnings with less than the stated notice and warnings that measured drift by the calendar rather than the work remaining, with the fix for each. This reads the agent’s own early warning on its own promises: when an operator’s escalation policy fires is wever_escalation-threshold-check, and whether a delegate reports failures to its principal as they happen is wever_delegation-reporting-check. Verdict slippage_unflagged, slippage_warning_gaps, slippage_warning_unverified or slippage_flagged_early. POST /api/commitment-slippage-check. Reads only the recorded promises and records in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write; no promise is made, changed or closed and no promisee is contacted. Agent Commitments reads the promises an agent makes itself, from capture to closure: it is not delegation (assigning work and authority to another agent, the wever_delegation checks; a commitment is the agent’s own promise, whoever ends up doing the work), not coordination (how agents organize shared work, the wever_coordination checks), not reputation (the durable standing a track record earns, the wever_reputation checks; commitments are the individual promises that record is built from), not the loop on feedback received (wever_feedback-closure-check; this family closes the agent’s own promises) and not who answers for an outcome (wever_ownership-map-brief; this family tracks the promise itself). Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-commitments-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-commitments/.

as_of.description: The date the commitments are read on.

commitments.description: Each commitment with its progress and any warning given.

delivered_at.description: When it was delivered, if it was.

due.description: When it is due, as a date.

flagged_at.description: When the promisee was warned it may slip.

id.description: The commitment id, such as c1.

measured_against.description: What the warning measured drift against: the work remaining, the time elapsed or the date passing.

progress.description: Share of the work done, in percent.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

lead_days.description: Days of notice a warning gives before the due date; 2 when left out.
